journey.title: From one Visnagar clinic to
journey.lede: Aakash Eye Hospital opened in Visnagar in 1993 as a single ophthalmic care setup. Every step since has been about bringing better diagnostics and surgical care closer to the patients who need them.
journey.milestonesTitle: How the hospital kept moving forward
journey.milestonesLede: The moments that shaped our clinical capability and our reach across Gujarat.

milestones.title: Founded at Visnagar
milestones.description: Aakash Eye Hospital started on 8 August 1993 in a town of nearly 100,000 people, with an initial 1,500 sq ft setup.

milestones.title: Phaco cataract surgery begins
milestones.description: The hospital became one of the pioneers in phaco cataract surgery in the region.

milestones.title: Excimer laser added
milestones.description: Excimer laser technology was introduced for glass removal and refractive procedures.

milestones.title: Retina diagnostics expanded
milestones.description: OCT, Green Laser and FFA capabilities were added for medical retina care.

milestones.title: Ahmedabad branch opens
milestones.description: The Odhav, Ahmedabad branch opened in a facility of approximately 5,500 sq ft.

now.label: Today
now.title: One hospital, many doorsteps
now.description: Patients are seen across our hospitals by a consultant team covering cataract, refractive, retina, glaucoma and paediatric eye care, and an old case file is welcome at any of them.

vision.title: Why this hospital
vision.lede: Our mission and vision were written for one thing: comprehensive eye care that a family in a small town can reach as easily as a family in a city.

statements.text: To excel in cutting-edge eye care technology, education and ophthalmology research while keeping care affordable.
statements.note: What we work on every day.

statements.text: To provide comprehensive ophthalmic services of international standards to all sections of society.
statements.note: Where we are taking the hospital.

vision.valuesLede: These are the operating rules behind consultation, surgery planning and follow-up.

values.title: Patient safety first
values.description: Careful protocols at every step, written to reduce errors and to keep surgery and follow-up predictable.

values.title: Care that stays affordable
values.description: Costs are explained before treatment, and affordability is part of how we plan care rather than an afterthought.

values.title: Technology in the right hands
values.description: Phaco, excimer laser, OCT and retina diagnostics are used by consultants who read the results with you.

values.title: Your file has no due date
values.description: Old case papers stay valid. Bring the previous file on a future visit and your history comes with you.

values.title: Teaching and research
values.description: Education and ophthalmology research keep the clinical team learning, and that learning reaches the OPD.

values.title: Open to every patient
values.description: Comprehensive ophthalmic services for all sections of society, at each of our hospitals.
